description: Reusable grouping axes, comparison matrix dimensions, and citation style conventions for Related Work organization.

recommended_grouping_axes.when_to_use: Use when prior studies solve distinct sub-problems, supervision regimes, or boundary conditions.
Use when prior studies differ in modeling mechanism, physical/chemical principle, or algorithmic family.
Use when conclusions diverge due to benchmark choice, operating conditions, or measurement metrics.

recommended_grouping_axes.when_to_use: Use when competing approaches excel in mutually exclusive regimes (e.g., high accuracy vs. low latency).
